messages:
Jordan: Hey team — Concord (Meridian Health) just asked if we can run a POC with a community model they trained: `meridian-7b-adapter-v2`.
Maya: Nice. Key asks from them?
Jordan: They want low-latency chat (p50 < 120ms) at ~10rps for a demo, and to try our quantized variant. Also need to confirm KV cache works with their adapter weights.
Leo: Quick notes — if it's standard transformers adapter on top of a GPT-like base, runtime should support it. Quantization path (int8) is OK but we need to know: hidden_size, head_count, seq_len typical (they said seq ~512).
Maya: I asked them for the model artifact details but FYI we typically need the converted checkpoint + config.json and tokenizer. Can they share s3 link or repo?
Jordan: Customer can share s3. Also asked about KMS and whether keys must stay in their AWS account.
Kat: Security checklist — for POC we can run isolated Dedicated pool, but need: SOC2 scope note, KMS binding, and Data Processing Addendum (DPA) flagged. Also confirm no PHI in demo data.
Priya: From product side — to onboard to catalog we need metadata: model id, variant names, quantization recipes attempted, estimated vram per sequence, and a small eval prompt set. Turnaround for a basic compatibility scan: 2 business days once artifacts arrive.
Leo: Re performance: with int8 and 512 seq, rough GPU mem ~10–12GB on A10G-ish; throughput at 10rps likely ok with batching disabled. If they want streaming tokens we might need to tune kv cache prewarm.
Jordan: Pricing question from them — will POC be billed at Hosted rates or do we offer trial credits / reserved short-term Dedicated pricing?
Priya: Offer: We can extend $X in credits for Hosted trial. For Dedicated short-term commit we can do a 1-week reserved at a reduced rate; SEs to confirm margin. I'll loop with finance if they request firm quote.
Maya: Ops ask — can we try a quick smoke run on staging? Leo, any quick commands to test artifacts once we have s3 path?
Leo: Yup, simplest:
```
redwoodctl artifacts validate --s3 s3://meridian/models/meridian-7b-adapter-v2
redwoodctl deploy --model meridian-7b-adapter-v2 --variant int8 --pool staging-small
```
That will run basic conversion + perf check. deploy-bot: compatibility-scan queued (job 8987).
deploy-bot: job 8987 started on runner-5, logs: https://ci.redwood.ai/jobs/8987
Maya: Great — once scan completes we can share perf + recommended quant/kv config with the customer and draft pricing options.
Kat: One more — ask them to fill the minimal security questionnaire (I posted the form link) before Dedicated access. For Hosted POC we can redact endpoints behind a temp token.
Jordan: I'll collect artifacts and questionnaire link today and drop them in the customer folder. ETA for s3 link: EOD PST.
Priya: Thanks — I'll prep an estimated POC quote draft and share in this thread when Leo posts scan results. :+1:
Jordan: 👍 will update here when I have the s3 link.
